channel.title: Quiet Days Books
channel.description: Small books for noticing the animal you live with, while they are here.

item.title: Things to Do With Your Dog Before They Die: A Gentle List
item.description: Things to do with your dog before they die, sorted by how much energy is left: favorite people and places, quiet days at home, and the sounds worth keeping.

item.title: Cat Sleeping Spots Meaning: What Each Place Tells You
item.description: Cat sleeping spots meaning: high places mean safety, boxes and laundry mean warmth and shelter, your spot means your scent and heat. Cats rotate spots too.

item.title: Why Does My Cat Follow Me? Reasons and What to Notice
item.description: Why your cat follows you: food timing, company, curiosity and routine. Most following is a sign of a bond; a sudden change is worth a call to your vet.

item.title: When Is a Dog Considered a Senior? Ages by Size
item.description: Vets call a dog senior in the last 25% of its expected lifespan: roughly 7 to 10 for most dogs, sooner for giant breeds, later for small ones.

item.title: Things to Do With Your Cat: Play, Quiet and Noticing
item.description: Things to do with your cat at home: hunting-style play, food puzzles, quiet company, safe time outside, and small ways to notice the life your cat already has.

item.title: Senior Dog Bucket List: Ideas Sorted by Energy Level
item.description: A senior dog bucket list built on what your dog already loves and can still do: ideas for good days, slow days and days at home, plus what to record now.
